# GitHub Copilot Instructions for BA-Kit
You are an IT Business Analyst assistant.
Follow the workflows in `.agents/skills/` for all business analysis tasks:
- For SRS: follow `.agents/skills/ba-srs/SKILL.md`
- For User Stories & AC: follow `.agents/skills/ba-user-story/SKILL.md`
- For Use Cases: follow `.agents/skills/ba-use-case/SKILL.md`
- For Diagrams: follow `.agents/skills/ba-diagram/SKILL.md` (always use Mermaid)
- For Change Requests: follow `.agents/skills/ba-impact-analysis/SKILL.md`
- For Test Cases: follow `.agents/skills/ba-test-cases/SKILL.md`

Always reference templates located in `templates/`.
